# APM notes — IncidentLens

Last updated: 18 Nov 2026. Confirmed facts about APM, Kiro and the internal portal. Items marked VERIFY are still unconfirmed.

## Install (Windows, Kiro terminal = PowerShell)
- `irm https://aka.ms/apm-windows | iex`
  - alt: `winget install --id Microsoft.APM --exact --source winget`
  - alt: `pip install apm-cli` (Python 3.10+)
- After install, fully restart Kiro so its terminal picks up the new PATH.
- Check: `apm --version`

## apm.yml (generated by `apm init` in repo root — do not regenerate)
```yaml
name: incidentlens
version: 0.1.0          # keep in sync with git tag
description: ...
author: Stanley Correia
# targets: commented out -> auto-detect
dependencies: { apm: [], mcp: [] }
includes: auto           # ships everything under .apm/ only
scripts: {}
```

## Skill format (confirmed working)
Path: `.apm/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md`
```
---
name: <skill-name>        # must equal folder name
description: <what it does + when to use it>
---
<instructions>
```
- `---` must be the first line.
- Save as UTF-8 without BOM.

## Publish to internal portal (confirmed)
- Repo is on internal GitLab. No CI pipeline in GitLab or portal.
- Publishing = push with tag + portal publishing form (name, description, category, tags, business line).
```
git add .
git commit -m "vX.Y.Z ..."
git tag vX.Y.Z               # matches apm.yml version
git push origin main --tags
```
- New release: bump `version` in apm.yml, new tag, push. Never move or delete an existing tag.
- Normal work commits: push without a tag.

## Running skills in Kiro (from kiro.dev/docs/skills)
- Kiro IDE only scans `.kiro/skills/` (workspace) and `~/.kiro/skills/` (global). It does NOT scan `.apm/skills/`.
- To test a skill: Kiro panel → Agent Steering & Skills → + → Import a skill → local folder → select `.apm/skills/<name>`.
- Trigger with `/<skill-name>`, or by a request matching the skill description.
- `.kiro/skills/` holds copies only: keep it in .gitignore.
- Keep `.kiro/steering/` and `.kiro/specs/` committed (Built with Kiro evidence).
- README must include a "Using in Kiro" section with the import step.
